approvals.reason: The inline values carry live pointer and viewport motion coordinates through CSS custom properties while all visual values remain theme-owned.
approvals.removalCondition: Remove when the live motion coordinates can be represented without a React inline style while preserving pointer, typing, and reduced-motion behavior.

approvals.reason: The root inline style emits the selected theme variables during server rendering so the first paint and hydration use the same theme.
approvals.removalCondition: Remove when the framework provides an equally early server-rendered theme bridge that prevents first-paint mismatch without an inline style.
